evidence: RUNTIME FACT HALF: all stated. Entry path /app: instruction.md:5 and integration.md:3. Start command 'node /app/server.js' from a cwd that may be outside /app: integration.md:3 (test.sh:104-111 launches exactly that, possibly from /tmp/submission). Port 0.0.0.0:3000 and GET /api/health: integration.md:3 (test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /). Storage: SQLite, default /app/app.db, DB_PATH honoured 'including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app': integration.md:9 (test.sh:97-102,109). NODE_PATH supply of Node 22, Express, better-sqlite3 and no install/build step: integration.md:5 (matches both Dockerfiles, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1). Seed path /assets/seed_data.json: instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7; seed holds no snippets. Accounts: none, stated at instruction.md:5, overview.md:3, policy.md:3, matching app_context.md:10. Symlink rule: integration.md:11 (test.sh:72-83). Fixed clock: none stated, and none is needed - the seed has no dates and no criterion grades a date or time-derived figure. 'six notes' in instruction.md:3 matches the six files. GRADED-IS-ASKED HALF: I traced all 3 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria to the notes; all but one detail map to a public sentence (ui.md:3-17, behaviour.md:3-13, security.md:3-5, integration.md:7-9). The exception: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:236 (cw_error_message_and_line, weight 1.0) says 'the app console must show the authored message and the one-based line number', and judge.toml:245 (cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line, weight 1.5) says 'the app console must show the authored message text and the one-based line number'. The public text, behaviour.md:3, only says 'Show a useful error message with a one-based line number for a thrown error ... the message is the text of the Error or rejected value' and behaviour.md:5 'show the reason'; it never says the error must be in the console pane, and policy.md:3 leaves layout to the builder. The functional prompt (prompt.md:13) tells the judge every listed step of a criterion must hold. Sibling criteria use location-free wording ('a visible time-limit reason must appear', 'refused with a visible reason in the app'), so the console placement here is an unstated requirement, which qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md 'No hidden requirements' asks reviewers to catch. No run measures this: the scripted golden evidence and the hosted Oracle run on an earlier candidate both use the golden, which logs errors to its console. No configured judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index.json scope line).
counterexample: Conforming alternative that could fail: an app whose console pane lists only console.* output and which shows a thrown error or unhandled rejection in a status strip or error banner next to the preview, e.g. 'Error: boom-7421 (line 4)'. It satisfies behaviour.md:3 in full, yet a judge applying judge.toml:236 and :245 literally ('the app console must show') fails both criteria, 2.5 weight of the functional dimension. Broken app that could pass was also tried: nothing in the runtime contract lets a non-conforming launch pass, since the gate cw_shared_saved_record needs a real server-backed save after browser storage is cleared.
suggested_fix: Make the two sides agree in one sentence. Either state the placement publicly in behaviour.md:3 ('Show errors in the console with ...'), or, with less constraint on the builder, reword judge.toml:236 and :245 from 'the app console must show' to 'the app must visibly show, in its console or another visible message area,'. Re-freeze and re-check the candidate afterwards.
